name: coupang-hanoi-helper
description: 쿠팡 베트남 직구 도우미 — 크롬 확장 + 견적·주문 백엔드

scripts.build:ext: esbuild lib/extension-entry.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=KBCalc --outfile=extension/vendor/calc.js --minify --target=chrome110 && node scripts/check-leak.mjs && node scripts/check-ext-syntax.mjs
scripts.pack:ext: npm run build:ext && cd extension && zip -qr ../coupang-hanoi-extension.zip . -x "*.DS_Store" && echo "생성: coupang-hanoi-extension.zip"
